_comment: Charter player text. Copied to config/charter/en_us.json on first boot; edit that copy. Placeholders in braces are filled in. A refusal can be reworded by adding reason.<key>.
page.title: Charter
link.collect_hover: Take what you are owed into your inventory
link.expired: That link has run out. Open the page again.
found.done: You founded {name}. Invite a second member to make it active.
invite.no_player: Nobody called {name} has been seen on this server.
grant.bad_power: That is not a power. Type the command again and pick one from the list.
grant.no_target: No player or office is called {name}.
vote.state.refused_at_execution: passed, but could not be carried out
votes.title: Open votes
votes.none: There is nothing for you to vote on.
votes.abstain_hover: Count toward quorum without taking a side
vault.title: The vault
vault.bad_currency: The vault takes cobblestone and diamonds.
vault.owed_left: Your inventory is full. Make room, then collect the rest from /charter vault.
notice.invited: {org} invited you to join. Type /charter to answer.
notice.activated: {org} has its second member and is now active.
notice.vote_opened: A vote opened in {org}: {about}. Type /charter vote to cast yours.
notice.vote_refused: A vote in {org} passed, but could not be carried out: {about}.
notice.office_filled: You now hold the office of {office} in {org}.
notice.office_vacated: You no longer hold the office of {office} in {org}.
notice.encircled: {site} is encircled. Nothing can be carried in until the ring is broken.
teleport.already_waiting: You are already waiting to be taken somewhere.
teleport.cooldown: Wait {seconds} more seconds before you travel again.
teleport.moved: You moved, so you stay where you are.
teleport.hurt: You were hurt, so you stay where you are.
teleport.no_bed: You have no bed to go home to, or it is in another dimension, or it is gone.
teleport.no_keep: Your nation holds no keep. Put a Nexus down to claim land.
teleport.no_outpost: Your organization has no outpost. Plant a war banner beside land that is not claimed to raise one.
teleport.outpost_raising: Your outpost is still being raised.
teleport.outpost_empty: Your outpost has no food to spare. Put some in its store.
teleport.nowhere: There is nowhere to take you; the keep or outpost has no marker left.
teleport.other_dimension: That is in another dimension. You can only travel within the one you are in.
teleport.done.outpost: You are at your outpost. The trip cost it some food.
outpost.inspect: The outpost of {org}. It holds a deposit of {deposit} diamonds.
notice.war_declared_on_you: {org} declared war on your outpost {site}. Capture cannot begin for {time}. Stock it and be ready to stand in its chunk.
notice.war_declared_by_you: You declared war on {org} to capture {site}. Capture cannot begin for {time}.
notice.war_opened_on_you: {org} may now try to take your outpost {site}. If any of your people stand in its chunk, they cannot.
notice.war_opened_by_you: You may now try to take {site} of {org}: hold its chunk with none of their people there.
notice.outpost_lost: {org} took your outpost {site} and its deposit of {deposit} diamonds.
notice.outpost_taken: You took {site} of {org} and its deposit of {deposit} diamonds. You alone may plant an outpost there for a while.
notice.war_lapsed: The war with {org} over {site} ran out and nothing was taken. You may not fight again for a while.
notice.keep_low: The granary of {site} is down to {days} days of food. Feed it, or its claim will lapse.
notice.keep_lapsed: The granary of {site} ran dry and its claim lapsed. Your blocks still stand, but the land is open. Put a new Nexus down to claim it again.
notice.contested: {count} of your claims lost their link to a keep. Link them again before the grace runs out.
notice.lapsed: {count} of your claims were lost: the grace ran out.
motion.unknown: something this server no longer knows
motion.election: elect someone to the office of {office}
motion.npc.spawn: raise a stronghold of the raiders
motion.contract.breach: declare a breach of a contract
admin.advanced: Siege time moved on by {by}. The siege clock is at {siege}.
admin.scaled: Time scale is {scale} until the server restarts. Set timeScale in charter.json to keep it.
admin.not_member: {player} is not a member of anything.
admin.aged: The membership of {player} now dates back {days} days further.
admin.dissolved: Dissolved {orgs}: {members} members set free, {keeps} keeps and {claims} chunks of land removed.
admin.npc_kind: The kind is stronghold or outpost.
admin.npc_no_room: There is no room for a site here: it must stand clear of every claim and keep.
admin.npc_ruins_claimed: The ground near {x}, {z} is claimed. Nothing was cleared.
admin.npc_ruins_none: Nothing of the raiders was found near {x}, {z}.
admin.npc_ruins_done: Cleared {count} blocks of the raiders near {x}, {z}.
admin.repaired: Repair found {count} thing(s) to put right. Each is in history.jsonl.
land.protected: This land belongs to {owner}. You may walk here, not build.
land.item.nexus_lore: Place it to raise a keep: the square of chunks around it becomes your faction's.
land.item.banner_lore: Plant it to raise an outpost. Anyone can pull it down while it raises.
land.nexus_placed: The keep of {org} stands. Its plot of chunks is claimed.
land.nexus_unbreakable: The nexus cannot be broken while its keep stands.
land.camp_raising: Your outpost is raising. It takes {hours} hours, and until then anyone can pull the banner down.
land.camp_cut_down: You pulled the banner down. The outpost is gone.
land.banner_stays: The banner of a raised outpost stands. Only a captured outpost loses it.
land.admin.spawned: {name} is founded, funded, and {player} holds a nexus and a war banner.
land.admin.no_core: There is no keep or outpost.
land.admin.raised: {camp} finished raising ({by} of siege time passed).
admin.areas_head: {count} held area(s) on the public land map (version {version}).
land.admin.created: Set the kingdom of {name}. Its Nexus stands at {x}, {y}, {z} and no one leads it yet.
land.admin.claims_not_top: {name} is not a faction; set the bonus on the top level organization.
land.admin.kingdom_on: {name} is now an admin kingdom: closed to new members, no claim cap, no keep upkeep, and its outposts cannot be warred on.
land.admin.claims_set: {name} now has a bonus of {bonus} claims, so it may hold {cap} in all.
map.legend: @ you   K keep core   k keep   C outpost   o farm   + free and next to your land (click to claim)   . free   green yours, red theirs
map.free_claimable: Chunk {x}, {z}: free. Click to claim it.
granary.title: Granary
granary.may_take: You may put food in and take it out.
granary.may_not_take: You may put food in. Taking it out needs the granary withdraw power.
granary.returned: Some of that food was not accepted and has been given back.
granary.locked: That store belongs to someone else while their keep stands.
granary.linked: This chest is now part of your keep's granary.
granary.linked_camp: This is now your outpost's store.
granary.already: That container is already part of a granary.
granary.wrong_chunk: A granary stands in its keep's core chunk, an outpost store in the banner's chunk.
granary.not_a_container: That is not a chest or a barrel.
granary.full: A granary takes at most {max} chests.
granary.not_touching: That chest does not touch the granary, so it stays an ordinary chest.
granary.no_banner: An outpost store must stand beside the war banner.
granary.no_core_here: No keep or outpost has its core chunk here.
granary.set: The container at {x} {y} {z} is now part of the granary or outpost store.
granary.removed: The container at {x} {y} {z} is no longer part of a granary.
granary.not_a_granary: There is no granary or outpost store container there.
granary.none: No granary or outpost store is set.
granary.list_line: {core}: {count} container(s) from {x} {y} {z}, {queued} item(s) queued for the next load
cell.bad_name: Name a cell with 1 to {max} characters, no bars.
cell.no_power: Only a judge may mark or remove a cell.
cell.not_your_keep: Stand inside one of your own keeps to mark a cell.
cell.exists: This keep already has a cell called {name}.
cell.start_blocked: Stand in open air with room for your head, inside the keep, to mark a cell.
cell.leaks: That space is not closed in. Walls, floor and ceiling must stop every way out, inside the keep.
cell.too_big: That space is too big or not closed in. A cell holds at most {max} blocks of air.
cell.marked: Cell {name} marked in {site}: {count} blocks of air. Prisoners are put where you stood.
cell.removed: Cell {name} is no longer a cell.
cell.unknown: Your faction has no cell called {name}.
cell.none: Your faction has no cells. Stand in a closed room in a keep and type /charter cell mark <name>.
arrest.done: {player} is in your custody. Sentence them before the custody lapses.
jail.leashed: The lead pulls you back to your captor.
jail.returned: You are put back in your cell.
jail.escaped: You are out of the cell. Nobody can call that a crime.
jail.freed: You are free. You are led out of the cell.
jail.tethered: You may not leave the keep you are bonded to.
jail.no_teleport: You cannot teleport while you are held.
jail.no_commands: You cannot use commands while you are held. Only /charter works.
execution.wait: You were executed. You wait {time} before you may act again.
banish.pushed: You are banished from that land and were sent back.
notice.arrested: {officer} of {org} has taken you into custody. A judge must sentence you soon or you go free. Teleports and commands are blocked.
notice.custody_lapsed: Nobody sentenced you in time. You are free.
notice.fined: {org} fined you {asked} diamonds. {paid} were taken from your safe.
justice.in_custody: {player} is in custody, {time} left to sentence.
justice.link_pardon_hover: End every sentence your organization or one below it imposed
justice.nobody: Nobody is in custody or held. Use a lead on someone standing on your land to arrest them.
justice.sentence_info: Custody lapses in {time}. This week they may still be punished for {week}.
justice.row_execute: Execute: a wait of {wait}, then banished for {banish}.
justice.link_bond_hover: Tether {player} to the keep so they work its land
justice.link_execute_hover: Kill {player} once; they keep their items
justice.link_fine_hover: Fine {player}; nothing is taken if their safe is empty
safe.balance: {count} diamonds. A fine is taken from here and nowhere else.
chronicle.players_only: Only a player can be handed a book.
chronicle.no_faction: You are not in a faction. The realm's Chronicle is /charter chronicle realm.
chronicle.realm_blocked: Something is in the way. Stand in open air.
chronicle.realm_placed: The Realm Chronicle now stands at {x} {y} {z}.
chronicle.realm_removed: That lectern no longer keeps the Realm Chronicle.
chronicle.realm_none_near: No Realm Chronicle lectern within 3 blocks.
chronicle.realm_empty: No Realm Chronicle lecterns yet. Use /charter admin realm-chronicle here.
scenario.unknown: There is no scenario called {name}. Try /charter admin scenario list.
scenario.stopped: The scenario stopped there. Fix that and run /charter admin scenario clear before trying again.
scenario.cleared: Took down {count} factions made by scenarios.
scenario.too_many_players: {count} players were named, but the scenario has only {roles} roles.
scenario.already_member: {player} already belongs to {org}. Run /charter admin scenario clear, or leave first.
scenario.cast_stand_ins: {count} roles are played by offline stand-ins.
scenario.no_role: The scenario names a role {role} that is not in any faction or among the outsiders.
scenario.no_faction: The scenario names a faction {faction} it never founds.
scenario.raised: Raised every outpost: the siege clock moved on {hours} hours.
scenario.rails_straight: Rails run along one axis only.
book.item.name: Charter of Rights and Freedoms
book.item.lore: Use it to see where you stand.
book.given: You have been given the Charter of Rights and Freedoms. Use it, or type /charter, to see where you stand.
book.newcomer.title: You belong to no faction
book.newcomer.soon: Founding and joining are coming to this book.
book.home.title: {org}
book.nexus.unnamed: Name a banner at an anvil and craft it with a lodestone: its name becomes your faction's.
book.found.need_diamonds: A keep costs {price} diamonds. You carry {have}.
book.found.done: {name} is founded. Its keep stands here. It needs a second member before it is more than a name.
book.newcomer.intro: Ask to join a faction, or found your own.
book.join.title: Join a faction
book.join.none: No factions yet. Found your own.
book.join.more: More factions exist than are listed here.
book.join.runs_keeps: The same hands run the keeps and the rest.
book.freedoms.no_vote: You cannot vote the ruler out or change how this faction is run. You can leave, or break away.
book.join.no_vote: Members cannot vote the ruler out. They can leave, or break away.
book.join.commune_rule: The members decide together, by vote.
book.holder.vote_newcomer: The members, by vote (you could vote once you are a member)
book.join.waiting: You have asked. Waiting for their answer.
book.found.title: Found your own
book.found.intro: A faction begins as a Nexus, placed where its keep will stand.
book.found.step_craft: Craft the Nexus from the lodestone and the banner
book.found.step_place: Place it where your keep should stand
book.found.cooldown: You founded a faction too recently. Wait {time}.
book.faction.vote_later: You can vote on changes in {time}.
book.faction.election_council: An election for {office} is open among the council that stepped down. Its members choose who keeps the seat.
book.seats.proposed: Put to the {office}. It passes when most of them agree.
book.war.title: War
book.war.intro: A nation goes to war for one thing: to capture another nation's outpost. Keeps are never taken.
book.war.need_outpost: You need a raised outpost of your own before you can declare war.
book.war.no_targets: No other nation has an outpost you could name.
book.war.against_waiting: {org} declared war on your outpost {site}. Nothing can be done to it for {time}.
book.war.against_open: {org} may now try to take your outpost {site}. If they hold its chunk for {minutes} minutes with none of your people in it, it is theirs. Stand in it to stop them. The war ends in {time}.
book.war.by_waiting: You named {site} of {org}. Capture cannot begin for {time}.
book.war.by_open: Capture of {site} of {org} is open. Hold its chunk for {minutes} minutes with none of their people in it. The war ends in {time}.
book.war.truce: A truce with {org} holds for {time}. Neither of you may declare on the other.
book.war.confirm_skin: You may do this because your nation holds a raised outpost of its own. If they win, it can be taken the same way.
book.war.confirm_notice: Nothing can be done to their outpost for {hours} hours. Then your people must hold its chunk for {minutes} minutes with none of theirs in it. The war ends after {total} hours.
book.war.confirm_lapse: If it ends with nothing taken, neither nation may declare on the other for {days} days. If you take it, you get its deposit and the banner comes down.
book.war.declared: War is declared. Both nations were told.
reason.war_not_a_nation: Only a nation declares war, not a sub-faction.
book.form.council_alone: A council of {count}, any one may act
book.rights.title: Your Rights
book.rights.intro: What you may do on your own in {org}.
book.rights.none: You hold no powers of your own here. Your say is your vote.
book.freedoms.title: Your Freedoms
book.freedoms.intro: What others do for {org}, and who decides.
book.freedoms.none: Nothing is held for you by anyone else.
book.limit: up to {n} diamonds at a time
book.holder.vote_you: The members, by vote (you can vote)
book.holder.vote_not_yet: The members, by vote (you cannot vote yet)
book.situation.title: Your situation
book.situation.owed: The treasury owes you {list}; it arrives when you have room.
book.vote.title: A vote
book.vote.gone: That vote is no longer there.
book.faction.keep_low: The granary lasts {days} more days. Feed it, or the keep's claim lapses.
book.faction.no_keep: This nation holds no keep. Put a Nexus down to claim land again.
book.faction.who_decides: Propose a change to who decides
book.faction.elect: Hold an election for a seat
book.faction.election_opened: An election is open. Cast your ballot.
book.reject.title: Turn away?
book.decides.title: Who decides
book.decides.intro: A commune is run by its members, so changing how it is run is their vote.
book.decides.proposed: Put to a vote of the members.
book.decides.own: You hold this office, so you may change how it is run yourself.
book.decides.to_council_alone: Become a council, any one may act
book.decides.to_members: Put a change to the members
book.decides.size_alone: How many seats? Any one holder may act.
book.decides.size_together: How many seats? A majority of the holders must agree.
book.decides.only: {now}. Only {who} decide this. You cannot vote it, but you can break away.
book.leave.title: Leave {org}
book.leave.confirm: Leave {org}? You cannot undo this. You give up any office you hold there.
book.leave.cooldown: The founding cooldown still applies afterwards: if you founded a faction or broke away in the last {days} days, you must wait before you can found one.
book.breakaway.title: Break away
book.breakaway.sub_vote: It takes a vote: more than half of ALL members who can vote must say yes. Not voting counts as no.
book.breakaway.cost_none: It costs nothing: your faction owns a keep, and it goes with you.
book.breakaway.cost_nexus: After the vote you have {hours} hours to place a Nexus, paid from your faction's own treasury ({price} diamonds). If you do not, nothing changes.
book.breakaway.stay: Whoever disagrees cannot stay in {parent}: their only choice is to leave, and then they have no faction.
book.breakaway.pending: The vote passed. {time} left to place a Nexus.
book.breakaway.has_subs: This faction has sub-factions. They leave it one by one, each by its own vote; a group cannot.
book.breakaway.ruler: You rule here. Abdicate first, then you can break away.
book.breakaway.flat_intro: A group of two or more can leave {org} and found a faction of its own. No vote is needed.
book.breakaway.flat_start: Start it, and others who want to come press the same button within {hours} hours.
book.breakaway.cost_diamonds: The one who starts pays {price} diamonds for the keep, from what they carry.
book.breakaway.starter_places: They name a banner at an anvil, craft it with a lodestone into a Nexus, and place it away from every keep.
book.breakaway.proposed: Put to a vote of your faction's members.
book.breakaway.cooldown: Afterwards nobody who comes along can found or break away again for {days} days.
book.breakaway.confirm_vote: Put breaking away to a vote of your members?
book.breakaway.confirm_group: Break away from this faction with the group?
book.calendar.seasons: The year has four seasons: {seasons}. Each lasts four weeks.
book.calendar.days: A week is seven days and a day is a real day. The Chronicle dates things by day, week and season.
book.decides.council_alone: A council of {n}, any one may act
